note.text: Delivered the source-level authority-neutral Tiber TUI slice in signed commit b1836a109d3db33c2607367091c7230cf9ba6de1. The default no-argument CLI streams typed isolated app-server events into a projection-only Ratatui UI, presents dynamic tool requests as inert proposals, bounds transport and transcript state, sanitizes terminal controls, supports responsive cancellation and child cleanup, and preserves the explicit native multi-agent review-orchestration requirement. Focused adapter/TUI/CLI tests, the repository pre-commit gate, post-commit Tiber harness gate, independent multi-lens review, and pushed CI run https://github.com/jwilger/ai-plugins/actions/runs/31559192824 all completed successfully. This remains a source-level slice; durable sessions, protocol-level turn interruption, and release packaging remain later work.
